lyrics:
[Intro: choppy nylon guitar, dusty kick drum]

[Verse 1: raspy lazy male voice]
Got here early, put a towel on the chair
Next to mine, like you'd be there
Ordered two of everything, drank them slow
Told the waiter you're on your way. He knows.

[Chorus: four-on-the-floor, bass, voice doubled]
Towel on the chair, towel on the chair
Holding your place in the sun
I'm not waiting, I'm just here
In case you want to come
Towel on the chair

[Verse 2: voice and guitar, kick steady]
Kid cannonballed and soaked your side
I dried it off with mine
Sun moved round and I moved too
Dragged your shade along with you

[Chorus: four-on-the-floor, bass, voice doubled]
Towel on the chair, towel on the chair
Holding your place in the sun
I'm not waiting, I'm just here
In case you want to come
Towel on the chair

[Break: guitar alone, handclaps, hummed]
Mm, mm. It's a good chair.

[Final Chorus: full beat, a second voice humming]
Towel on the chair, towel on the chair
Holding your place in the sun
I'm not waiting, I'm just here
In case you want to come
Towel on the chair

[Outro: guitar chop fades, a glass set down]
